subjects: Cracked Armor Warden: hulking nonhuman hollow armor, chipped ivory ceramic mask without visible human face, massive asymmetric oxidized bronze left shoulder and long dark shield-blade, exposed ribs on back, ragged charcoal cloak. Broad heavy silhouette. Low horizontal animal silhouette, no rider. Six poses: 1 standing stalking, 2 low running with legs extended, 3 crouch gathering for leap, 4 airborne pouncing with front claws out, 5 skid landing head low, 6 side recoil hurt.

Soul Stitcher: nonhuman tall floating empty charcoal and desaturated plum robes with thin ivory ceramic mask and two extraordinarily long articulated bronze arms, dangling threads of muted pale gold from fingers. No human skin, no feet, sharply vertical silhouette. Six poses: 1 floating idle, 2 drifting with robes trailing, 3 both hands gather threads windup, 4 arm extends whipping threads toward right, 5 hands lowered recovering, 6 recoils with torn threads.
